text: 854 uses kvstore-gtest in Cargo metadata and kvstore_gtest in Rust source. Follow the language boundary: package names can contain hyphens while Rust identifiers use underscores. The current as _ form also documents link-only usage. This is a precise local naming convention, not a rule to rename all test files or project identifiers.
title: Keep Cargo package spelling distinct from Rust crate identifiers
